title: Craigs-digital-experience
description: Digital Experience / UX view for NatWest: real-user journey health (payment success, experience availability, customer-perceived latency) and per-city p95 network latency. Surfaces the madrid-network-degradation chaos scenario as a red Madrid tile. Live from otel_traces + nwpay_audit + ITSI service health. Adds per-tier experience, ThousandEyes synthetic monitoring, and drilldowns to the live Splunk Observability RUM / Synthetics / APM views (eu2).

options.query: search index=itsi_summary scoretype=service_health serviceid=nwpay_l2_experience | stats latest(health_score) as health | eval health=round(health,0)
| makeresults | eval v="Flow View  ▸"
search index=nwpay_audit sourcetype="nwpay:payment_audit" decision=* | timechart span=10m count as tot count(eval(decision="accepted")) as ok | eval success=round(ok/tot*100,2) | fields _time success
search index=itsi_summary scoretype=service_health serviceid=nwpay_l2_experience | timechart span=5m latest(health_score) as health | eval health=round(health,0)

search index=otel_traces sourcetype="otel:traces" (kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER" OR span_kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER") | timechart span=5m p95(attributes.network.latency_ms_simulated) as p95 | filldown p95 | fields _time p95
search index=nwpay_audit sourcetype="nwpay:payment_audit" decision IN ("rejected","review","throttled","error") | stats dc(customer_id_hash) as cust
